iti78:3.2: Those who have inferior convictions came together and converged with those who have inferior convictions,
iti78:3.3: Those who have good convictions came together and converged with those who have good convictions.
iti78:4.2: Those who have inferior convictions will join together and converge with those who have inferior convictions,
iti78:4.3: Those who have good convictions will join together and converge with those who have good convictions.
